units.source_text: 阿光吓得心里扑咚直跳，又不能正面瞧僵尸般的阿留一眼，

en.t: Ah Guang was so frightened that her heart pounded wildly, and she could not even look straight at A Liu, who seemed like a corpse,

units.source_text: 眼里映现的只是朦朦胧胧不断扩大的马皮。

en.t: all that appeared before her eyes was the horsehide, dim and hazy, swelling larger and larger.

units.source_text: 她似听非听，脑子里充满了自怜的思绪。

en.t: She seemed to be listening and yet not listening, her mind filled with thoughts of self-pity.
